meta.source: tierra-llc.com assets/site.css (live 08a507c), assuredforge.com site-w11 (shared tokens), b2 concept screens (type, status, data colours)

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings on surface and surface-alt; the brand's deep navy; the T of the Tierra mark and the peak of the AssuredForge mark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, captions, table headers, helper text on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs and the website page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: App page background behind cards; alternate table rows; quiet bands.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons at rest: 3:1 or more on surface and surface-alt in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Hairlines that only separate content keep using rule.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary buttons, selected states, focus rings, the main data series.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons and links (accent-ink on it: 9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (primary button labels).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected navigation item, info banners, chips on surface; text on it uses ink or accent.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Background of the Tierra bar in both themes (deep navy); never changes with the theme, so the reversed marks and gold stay readable on it.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bar (about 13:1); the search field uses it at 12% over bar.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold: the base of the Tierra T, the check of the AssuredForge mark, rules, underlines, icon details and graphics. Never for small text (3.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-family text where text must carry the gold tone, e.g. warning labels; meets 4.5:1 on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, passed, signed, verified: status text and icons.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners, with success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting for you, attention needed, expiring soon: status text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners, with warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, refused, destructive actions (only once confirmed): text, icons, the border of a destructive button.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and failed badges, with danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: text and icons of info banners.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the main measure). Order of use: viz-1 to viz-6.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2; lighter than viz-1 so the two differ in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5; also 'other' and 'not measured'.

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6; never next to danger in the same chart.

families.display: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of list rows and small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a page's first section on websites.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section spacing; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, progress bars, toggles.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything clickable or tappable.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside text and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and navigation.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons; the icon drawing grid.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of app page content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of website and Help text columns (64rem, as on tierra-llc.com).

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Below this viewport width wide layouts stack vertically: the run pipeline turns vertical, side-by-side panels become one column.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (with a rule border).

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.
